name: Session notes from dictation
summary: Turns a dictated or transcribed clinical visit into a draft treatment note in Cliniko, and queues the lock for a clinician to approve. Crons read and draft; a clinician approves every lock.

dictated-session.evidence: 2 discovery calls read; neither describes a variant, so the steps come from the platform docs

covered_by.consult-captured: outside the kit (the dictation or scribe tool records the visit)
covered_by.transcribe: outside the kit (Cliniko does not transcribe)
covered_by.clinician-review: skill (the clinician checks the draft in Cliniko, then a person marks the session reviewed)
covered_by.file-record: draft (Cliniko saves the note against the patient on create)

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Write each ready session to Cliniko as a draft treatment note.

crons.name: check
crons.summary: Read drafts back to see whether a clinician locked them in Cliniko, and follow queued locks to their outcome.

crons.name: sign
crons.summary: Queue the lock for each session a clinician has marked reviewed. It runs only when a person approves it.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the practice: a treatment note saved as draft against a patient, and reads of that note. The lock (saving a note as final in Cliniko) is a live operation and waits for a person's approval.

cliniko.covers: draft treatment note from a session, read-back of its draft flag, lock (save as final), filed to the patient record

gaps: Dictation, transcription and AI scribe capture are judgment steps outside the kit. Cliniko does not transcribe; the practice's dictation or scribe tool produces the sections.

Lyrebird Health (Medow) and ZedMed (with Heidi) describe dictation and scribing, but neither has an ops file in core/sdk/platforms, so neither has an adapter. Their pages are vendor marketing, not API docs.
Letters and referrals: Cliniko describes them, but the ops file maps no letter or referral operations, so nothing is built for them.
Billing item numbers: the Cliniko docs do not say how item numbers attach from a note, so nothing is built for billing.
Recalls and follow-up tasks from note actions: the docs describe recall types but not a note creating a recall, so nothing is built for follow-ups.

Session intake: no command in tools/workflow.ts adds a session. The agent or the CRM shell writes the session record (status transcript-ready, with its sections) into the sessions store. No runtime change was made.
The reviewed mark: a person sets a session to reviewed in the CRM shell. Confirm the shell offers that status before relying on the sign cron.
Cliniko has not been run against a live account. The lock (PATCH with draft false), the role limits and the template ids need a live check.

evidence.calls: 2 calls read; 0 variants described (variants file has no steps)
evidence.platforms: 3 platform pages read: Cliniko help centre (29 pages, mapped to 223 ops in the kit), Lyrebird Health and ZedMed vendor pages (no ops in the kit). Only Cliniko has mapped operations.
